d:
Bihar men phud prosesing yunit ko barhava dene aur nae nivesh ki sanbhavnaon ko lekar kendriy mantri chirag pasvan ne bara bayan diya hai. unhonne bihar men phud prosesing sektar ke vikas ke rodmaip par apni bat rakhi. kya hai chirag pasvan ka vijan aur bihar ke kisanon va yuvaon ko isse kya phayda ho sakta hai? dekhie puri riport...
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
